commenti.body:
Nice thoughts for the mistakenly maligned capper to the Wright-Pegg-Frost trio of high-concept comedies.

I disagree entirely with your penchant for using anything Gary King related when talking to your friends, especially when it comes to drinking culture bullying.

I've lost friends before due to this kind of behaviour, where I had to pull out of attending any evenings or nights out with them because of their incessant peer pressure and goading tactics seemingly in an attempt to justify their own alcoholism.

Just don't do it.

After all, didn't the noble Andy Knightley teach us that it takes balls to order a water in a pub of tanked-up rugby players...?
You put my review in a new light that I failed to see before. Thank you for the added perspective.
